items.text: Mine your top two titles side by side: new cards take turns, each title's most useful word first.
Piyo's "the words I learned today" gives only the words first learned today.
Mark a word Known or Ignore straight from its word card; press again to undo.
YouTube downloads go in their own channel folder; an old Processed title is split by channel, once.
New arrivals keeps a channel's new videos in one row.
